title: Sparse Keller maps
plain: List every Jacobian-conjecture counterexample in 3D built from at most 12 monomials in total, up to symmetry.
math: Classify all non-invertible Keller maps $\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3$ whose three components together have at most 12 monomials, up to affine changes of coordinates.
